# Juan Pablo Armstrong

> Cloud engineer in Temuco, Chile, who designed, deployed and operates VecinoClub, a serverless loyalty platform in production on AWS. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and AWS Re/Start 2026 graduate.

VecinoClub runs on Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, CloudFront, S3 and SES, with a FastAPI/Python backend, a React 19 + TypeScript frontend, and CI/CD through GitHub Actions and AWS SAM. It is multi-tenant and live with its first merchant, Imaquinaria. Over 30 days it served 3,397 requests with 0% 5xx errors and 151 ms p50 latency, monitored with CloudWatch, X-Ray and SNS alarms; 23 ADRs record its architecture and cost decisions. Before the cloud, Juan Pablo spent 10+ years running his own businesses in web development and design. He is open to remote roles and to on-site or hybrid roles in Temuco. English: advanced (C1). Contact: j.p.armstrong@me.com. Every page is also available in Spanish; links to the Spanish versions are under Optional.

## VecinoClub

- [Case study](https://jparmstrong.vercel.app/en/project): What the customer portal and merchant dashboard do, the AWS architecture, and the decisions behind it.
- [ADR-0003: HTTP API over REST API](https://jparmstrong.vercel.app/en/project/adr/ADR-0003-http-api-over-rest-api): Why the platform uses HTTP API, including the cost difference ($1 vs $3.50 per million requests).
- [ADR-0006: AWS production architecture](https://jparmstrong.vercel.app/en/project/adr/ADR-0006-aws-production-architecture): Domain, Lambda, SSM and logging decisions for the first production deployment.
- [ADR-0019: Data migration runner](https://jparmstrong.vercel.app/en/project/adr/ADR-0019-data-migration-runner): The root-cause analysis of a production data incident and the DynamoDB migration runner built to prevent it from happening again.
- [ADR-0023: IAM roles as IaC](https://jparmstrong.vercel.app/en/project/adr/ADR-0023-iam-roles-as-iac): How IAM permissions are managed as infrastructure as code.
